The May 2023 bill is the only month without a text copy, and its content is represented as a binary value. I need to inspect the in-memory value's type, length, and prefix to determine how to decode it without guessing.

```python
may_content_type = type(electricity_bill_records[-1]['content'])
may_content_length = len(electricity_bill_records[-1]['content'])
may_content_prefix = electricity_bill_records[-1]['content'][:200]
print({'type': may_content_type.__name__, 'length': may_content_length, 'prefix': may_content_prefix})
```
